column3: Its command to walk serves idolatrous social pressure, a limited contrary use of movement rather than measured gait.
Lowering the gaze supplies a parallel discipline of reducing an outward faculty to preserve ethical boundaries.
Permitted movement across the earth is not itself a norm of moderation or vocal restraint.
Directly prohibits raising voices above the Prophet, giving a concrete social limit for the focus's lowered voice.
The immediately preceding command rejects proud walking, supplying the excess that the focus corrects through measured gait.
The donkey image creates a limited animal parallel, though its subject is frightened flight rather than harsh sound.
Straight following is joined to voices lowered until only a whisper remains, closely pairing directed movement and subdued sound.
Its same-surah promise of guidance and mercy offers only a broad frame for the counsel on conduct.

The command to speak well to people supplies a broad interpersonal counterpart to avoiding harsh vocal expression.

Commands recognized, fitting speech in financial care, a practical instance of regulated address.
